gate.feature: within-fold percentile rank of 1-cosine(arm_C, arm_D) on the frozen operator axis
gate.development_rank_scope: separate complete 221-target rank inside each HCT116/HEK293T experiment-064 fold
gate.production_rank_scope: all 248 joint K562/PerturbMatch-supported targets inside the complete 300-target VCC panel before KOLF authentication; unsupported targets use sentinel -1 and exact D
gate.selection: maximum two-donor macro realized raw-PDS gain among rules nonnegative in both donors
gate.tie_break: fewer switches, smaller quantile fraction, then low direction

production_arms.donor_weights: equal among donors carrying each target
production_arms.arm_C: incumbent main donors plus complete mean3 post-whitening CD4 residual
production_arms.arm_D: arm C with 50:50 PerturbMatch replacement of the K562 slot where jointly supported

held_truth.name: KOLF2.1J
held_truth.representation: decoded raw quantized z-score, centered per gene
held_truth.control_reason: b_ctrl.npy is an all-ones compatibility placeholder, not an analogous biological control profile

source_clusters.input: complete 300-row production arm-D query on the production whitening-operator axis

kolf_promotion_gate.matched_routing_null: uniformly reallocate the frozen C-route count among PM-supported KOLF targets; unsupported targets remain D
